text: Implemented typed CSV/TSV schema and lossless RawRecording import: delimiter/header, timestamp and coordinate units, validity codebook, pupil semantics, global plus column-specific missing tokens, marker fields, native metadata, source lines, frame/clock specs, measured origins, and pure cross-platform SHA-256. Validation partitions every data row into accepted or rejected, accumulates field diagnostics, rejects nonmonotonic timestamps, and converts out-of-frame tracked positions to OffScreen. Checked conformance fixture is derived and attributed to the public MIT-licensed AdSERP pupil-data example (DOI 10.1145/3726302.3730325), retaining malformed/missing cases. Evidence: full io suite 11/11 JVM and 11/11 Scala.js; file-scoped scalafmt and diff checks pass; parser, line-number, unit, and dropped-row mutants all failed and were restored.
